core_obligations: Sheaf property and stack presentation (proof lines 2540-2546): Quot is a sheaf; pass to the stack in groupoids; reduce to algebraicity of the stack.
Representability reduction (proof lines 2547-2561): the forgetful 1-morphism to the algebraic stack of coherent sheaves needs only to be representable by algebraic spaces.

The fibre product (proof lines 2562-2588): Z is a stack in setoids whose sheaf assigns the surjections F_{T'} -> G_{T'}; it is an open subspace of the Hom algebraic space by the surjectivity-open lemma.
proof_roadmap: Verify the sheaf property and form the Quot stack (proof lines 2540-2546).
Reduce to representability of the forgetful morphism to Cohstack (proof lines 2547-2561).
Describe the 2-fibre product and realize it as an open subspace of Hom (proof lines 2562-2588).
